markdown:
*Vehicle, civilian*

Sedans are the bread and butter of city traffic. If not a sedan, it's a van. Sedans are of the most commercially available vehicles to Neon City's residents and perform well during all times of the year before their warranties expire. Many sedans are designed for in-city use along the self-driving network.

Not all models are built equally. The standard sedan sports four doors with a front engine with the niceties many have come to know and love, including radio, GPS, cooling/heating vents. The Model M Tudor and Dudebaker Six are one of the most common to be seen on the streets. The more luxury models, such as [Kazanari](/corp:kazanari-automotive)'s own Caliburn and Midnight Type-D, are built for the discerning customer with the desire to wow riders and observers alike. Comes with their own SuckJon 500™ with on-call warranty. For the discerning driver, looking for more bang for their buck, the AE86 Bumblebee comes equipped with an upgraded engine block, enhanced brake pads utilizing a pincer design, and two Type-701 Armata Gattling Guns installed, fully stocked, and prepared to fire, from 0 to 2000 RPM, in less than 3 seconds at the press of a button. And for those on a budget, the 500C Bareback is an option many opt for when rent is higher than normal.

*Sedan · *Large vehicle (car) (3,000 lb, 2x3 squares)* · **Creature Capacity** Up to 5 Medium creatures · **Cargo Capacity** 850 lbs. · **Armor Class** 20 (18 when stationary) · **Hit Points** 80 (damage threshold 10, mishap threshold 20) · **Speed** 120 ft. · STR — DEX — CON — INT — WIS — CHA · 16 (+3) — 14 (+2) — 16 (+3) — 0 (—) — 0 (—) — 0 (—) · **Saving Throws** (—) · **Damage Immunities** poison, software · **Condition Immunities** blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned, unconscious · ***Hit and Run.*** A sedan can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature. When it does, the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. If the creature was already prone, it takes an extra 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage. This trait can’t be used against a particular creature more than once each turn. · ***Prone Deficiency.*** If a vehicle rolls over and falls prone, it can’t right itself and is incapacitated until flipped upright. · ***City Driver.*** A sedan requires a paved road to be fully effective. A sedan moves at half speed when being driven in terrain that is not a paved road (either bricks, smooth paved roads, etc.). · Action Stations · ***Driver (Requires 1 Crew and grants Half Cover).*** Drive and steer the vehicle. · ***Passenger (grants Half Cover).*** Sits in one of the other four available seats.*
